source.title: On the Intraday Behavior of Bitcoin
source.author: Giacomo De Nicola

supporting_source.title: Short-horizon mean reversion in cryptocurrency markets: a matched cross-market measurement

hypothesis: Large 4-hour crypto price moves partially reverse over the next 4-hour bar because of overreaction, excess volatility and leveraged-liquidation cascades. Conditioning on standardized move magnitude should improve the reversal edge and reduce turnover relative to unconditional sign reversal.
universe: Binance USD-M USDT perpetuals listed by 2021-12-31. At each 4-hour decision point, retain top 20 by lagged trailing-30-day quote volume among contracts with exact 4-hour history.
bar_construction: Aggregate complete 1h bars to UTC-aligned 4h OHLCV bars.
signal: At 4h bar t open, use only completed bar t-1: z = return(t-1) / trailing 30-day std of prior completed 4h returns. If abs(z)>=threshold, hold -sign(return(t-1)) during bar t.
portfolio: Equal-weight triggered positions across contemporaneously eligible top-20 liquid assets; maximum gross exposure 1.0; flat when none trigger.
execution: Signal is formed after prior 4h close; enter at next 4h open and exit/rebalance at the following 4h boundary. No same-bar signal/fill contamination.
development_gate: Canonical net daily-equity Sharpe >0.70, total return >0, and at least 2/3 preregistered thresholds positive after base costs.
success_gate: Canonical OOS net Sharpe >1.0; positive at 2x costs; at least 2/3 thresholds positive; 2024 and 2025 each non-negative; max drawdown <35%; excluding BTC/ETH positive; excluding strongest contributor positive; DSR reported.
source_deviation: The primary source documents mean reversion mainly in Bitcoin at 1h/2h/4h. This test extends the same causal 4h mechanism across a broad ex-ante Binance perpetual universe and adds a fixed move-size filter because the source reports stronger reversals after larger moves.
